comment: The square fold at CoordinateFolder.cpp:63-65 takes each coordinate modulo ten over the amount, and the radial fold at lines 67-71 takes the angle modulo two pi over the amount and rebuilds the point at the same distance from the origin. The modulation at line 48 is a crossfade between the knob and the jack voltage plus one, not a scaled addition, so a fully turned modulation knob discards the amount knob entirely. The result is passed through std::abs, so a negative amount gives the same fold as its positive.
